<!-- rpc-coverage: kind=service service=Discovery first-seen=v0.2.0 methods=Watch -->

Core `v0.2.0` has a user-facing method in the `Discovery` service that the Go SDK does not wrap yet: `Watch`. The SDK wraps none of the service's user-facing methods, so this issue tracks the service as a whole. First seen in core `v0.2.0`.

**Blocked on bindings generation**: the SDK does not generate bindings for `proto/discovery.proto` yet. Add the `M` option for the file to both plugins in `buf.gen.yaml` and run `mise run proto:gen` first. If the core tag pinned on `main` does not contain every method listed here yet, do this on the bump branch `core/v0.2.0`, which core-watch opens as the bump proposal for core `v0.2.0`; it does not exist yet.

## `Discovery.Watch`

Watch streams routes. Text from core such as {{BRIEF}} stays as is.

- Streaming: bidirectional streaming
- Authorization: `dual`, scope `discovery:read`, global role `admin`
- Definition: [`proto/discovery.proto`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.2.0/proto/discovery.proto#L5-L7) at core `v0.2.0`
- Generated bindings on the SDK's `main`: no

```proto
rpc Watch(stream WatchRequest) returns (stream google.protobuf.Empty) {}
```

Request and response messages:

```proto
message WatchRequest {}
```

`google.protobuf.Empty` (definition not in core's `proto/`, for example a well-known type)

## Where core implements it

### `Discovery.Watch`

- Server (`crates/openshell-server/src`): not found
- Rust SDK (`crates/openshell-sdk/src`): not found
- TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript/src`): not found

## Implementation brief

Copy this block as the task description when you start the work.

````text
Wrap the Discovery service of OpenShell core in the OpenShell Go SDK (https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go): method Watch.

Core version: NVIDIA/OpenShell at tag v0.2.0.
Branch: start from main if the core tag pinned there (buf.gen.yaml, inputs[0].tag) already declares Watch in proto/discovery.proto, otherwise from core/v0.2.0, the core bump proposal for v0.2.0 (core-watch has not opened it yet). First add the M option for the file to both plugins in buf.gen.yaml and run `mise run proto:gen`.

Read first:
- AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md in the SDK repository: conventions, commands, and commit rules.
- Discovery.Watch: proto definition https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.2.0/proto/discovery.proto#L5-L7; core server: not found
- The pattern to follow: the sub-client in openshell/v1/service_client.go, its types in openshell/v1/types/service.go, its converter in openshell/v1/internal/converter/service.go, and its fake in openshell/v1/fake/service.go.

Deliverables:
- A sub-client in openshell/v1 for the Discovery service, behind an interface like the other sub-clients, that constructs pb.NewDiscoveryClient(conn) and is reachable from Client.
- Domain types in openshell/v1/types/ without proto imports.
- Converters in openshell/v1/internal/converter/ that deep-copy slices and maps.
- The fake implementation in openshell/v1/fake/.
- Unit tests with bufconn and testify.
- Documentation: a page under docs/src/api/ (like docs/src/api/services.md) with its entry in docs/src/SUMMARY.md, or an update of the existing page.

Done when `mise run ci` passes. Use Conventional Commits and sign off every commit.
````

## About this issue

The RPC coverage automation (`hack/automation/rpc-issues.sh`, run by the hourly core-watch workflow) opened this issue and keeps it in sync with the newest core release tag.
It rewrites this description when the definition or the buildability changes, and closes the issue when the SDK covers every method listed here under `openshell/v1`, when core removes them or makes them internal, or when they are listed with a reason in [`hack/automation/rpc-exceptions.txt`](https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go/blob/main/hack/automation/rpc-exceptions.txt).
An issue closed by hand stays closed. Reopen it by hand to keep it open while the automation considers the methods covered.
